key.name: enabled
key.description: Apply the accent colour derived from the current wallpaper.

key.name: highlight-mode
key.description: When enabled, use the wallpaper highlight colour instead of the dominant colour.

key.name: wp-source
key.description: Choose between the current wallpaper and a Bing wallpaper.

key.name: icon-theme-src
key.description: Choose whether to use the user's icon theme, the wallpaper hue, or the shifted wallpaper hue.

key.name: gtk-theme-src
key.description: Choose whether to use the user's GTK theme, the wallpaper hue, or the shifted wallpaper hue.

key.name: accent-color-src
key.description: Choose whether to use the user's accent colour, the wallpaper hue, or the shifted wallpaper hue.

key.name: saturation
key.description: Set the saturation of the wallpaper accent colour.

key.name: hue-shell-shift
key.description: Shift the wallpaper hue used for the shell theme.

key.name: hue-accent-shift
key.description: Shift the wallpaper hue used for the accent colour.
